description: What does fund <investor> hold (institutional 13F portfolio) — every long position an institutional filer reported in its latest SEC Form 13F. Identified by the fund's 10-digit zero-padded SEC CIK (e.g. Berkshire Hathaway = 0001067983). Returns ticker, shares, market value, and report period per position. Example: fd_investor_portfolio({ filer_cik: "0001067983", limit: 50, _apiKey: "your-key" })

filer_cik.description: The fund's SEC filer CIK, 10-digit zero-padded, e.g. "0001067983" (Berkshire Hathaway). This endpoint requires a CIK, not a fund name.

name: fd_investor_portfolio
title: Fd Investor Portfolio
